texto: **Il me semble que** (I think you're right) introduces a soft, indicative opinion: **Il me semble que tu as raison** (I think you're right).
**À mon sens** (in my opinion), **quant à** (as for): **Quant à moi, je suis d'accord** (as for me, I agree).
**En définitive** (in short) and **au fond** (in short) close the opinion: **En définitive, on part demain** (in short, we leave tomorrow).

Le plan est bon, à mon sens.
Quant à moi, je suis d'accord.

bloques.pregunta: What does «il me semble que» mean?

opciones.explicacion: Introduce a subjective opinion or impression with an indicative mode.
I would express surprise by «je suis surpris que» (+ subjunctive).
I would express positive feeling through «je suis heureux que».

bloques.pregunta: What is the right way for «I think you're right.»?

opciones.texto: Il me semble que tu as raison.
opciones.explicacion: When it has a dative pronoun («il me semble»), it is usually indicative.

opciones.texto: Il me semble que tu aies raison.
opciones.explicacion: The subjunctive is traditionally used when it is not pronoun («il semble que»).

opciones.texto: Il me semble tu as raison.
opciones.explicacion: The complete conjunction «que» is missing.
«À mon sens» = in my opinion, in my opinion.
Private preposition («without») that has no discursive relationship.
Positive causation («thanks to»), inconsistent in this context.
Topical locution «quant à» = as to / as to me.
Conductive connector («despite the») that does not fit the opinion agreement.
Private Preposition («without») inadmissible in this emphatic position.

bloques.frase: Il me semble que tu as raison.

opciones.explicacion: Precise translation of epistemic attenuation «il me semble que».
It confuses the impression of truth with the surprise.

opciones.texto: I don't think you're right at all.
opciones.explicacion: It denies and contradicts the original soft feeling.
«En définitive» recapitulates and delivers a deliberation.

opciones.texto: At first, we wanted to leave tomorrow.
opciones.explicacion: Confusion the conclusion with an initial reference («au début»).

opciones.texto: Yesterday we decided never to leave.
opciones.explicacion: It completely distinguishes the date and the affirmative polarity.

bloques.explicacion: A locution that nuances the underlying truth.

bloques.pregunta: What adverbial locution expresses the underlying essential reality («in substance»)?

opciones.explicacion: It is fixed that it introduces the most profound or determining aspect of a matter.
«por consiguiente» or «since then»-equivalent consecutive connector.
Adverse locution that means «en vano» or «inútilmente».
